title: RESEARCHHUB: A Personalized Literature Discovery System for Biomedical Preprints
abstract: arXiv:2610.28636v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present ResearchHub, an interactive system for personalized literature discovery over biomedical preprints. Given a researcher profile or a free-form query, ResearchHub retrieves relevant papers from a domain-specific MedRxiv corpus and helps users move beyond near-duplicate recommendations through controllable novelty, diversity, and curriculum ordering. At the core of the system is prism, a bi-encoder retriever adapted to biomedical preprints using GPT-4o-generated natural language queries and a hybrid Multiple Negatives Ranking plus MarginMSE objective with cross-encoder soft labels. On 44,937 MedRxiv papers from 2023--2025, prism outperforms strong off-the-shelf dense retrievers, improving Recall@10 over SPECTER2-Search by 12.4 percentage points. ResearchHub further supports frontier retrieval based on a user's reading history, DPP-based diversity re-ranking, Local Intrinsic Dimensionality ordering from mainstream to specialized

translated_title: ResearchHub：面向生物医学预印本的个性化文献发现系统
translated_abstract: 我们提出了ResearchHub，一个面向生物医学预印本的交互式个性化文献发现系统。给定研究人员画像或自由格式的查询，ResearchHub从特定领域的MedRxiv语料库中检索相关论文，并通过可控的新颖性、多样性和课程式排序，帮助用户超越近似重复的推荐。系统的核心是prism，一个针对生物医学预印本适配的双编码器检索器，它使用GPT-4o生成的自然语言查询，以及结合交叉编码器软标签的混合式多负例排序加MarginMSE训练目标。在2023至2025年的44,937篇MedRxiv论文上，prism超越了强大的现成密集检索器，相比SPECTER2-Search将Recall@10提升了12.4个百分点。ResearchHub还进一步支持基于用户阅读历史的前沿检索、基于行列式点过程（DPP）的多样性重排序，以及从主流到专业领域的局部内在维度排序。
tldr: 本文提出ResearchHub个性化文献发现系统，其核心检索器prism通过GPT-4o生成查询和混合训练目标适配生物医学预印本，在MedRxiv语料上将Recall@10较SPECTER2-Search提升12.4个百分点，并支持可控新颖性、多样性与课程式排序。
en_tdlr: ResearchHub is a personalized literature discovery system for biomedical preprints whose core retriever prism, adapted via GPT-4o-generated queries and a hybrid training objective, improves Recall@10 by 12.4 percentage points over SPECTER2-Search while enabling controllable novelty, diversity, and curriculum ordering.
